questions.question: Which railway station received the National Energy Conservation Award 2025 as the Best Performing Unit in the Transport Category (Railway Station)?

questions.question: Which honour was conferred on Vaibhav Suryavanshi in 2025 for his exceptional achievements in cricket at a young age?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**PM Rashtriya Bal Puraskar.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__** 

__
 
• **Vaibhav Suryavanshi received the PM Rashtriya Bal Puraskar in 2025, conferred by President Droupadi Murmu, for his record-breaking achievements in cricket.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__** 

__
 
• **Vaibhav Suryavanshi is the youngest centurion in List A cricket, Syed Mushtaq Ali Trophy, and IPL history.**
 
• **He scored 190 runs off 84 balls in the Vijay Hazare Trophy, breaking AB de Villiers’ List A record.**
 
• **He is the youngest player to feature in the IPL and also the youngest IPL centurion.**
 
• **The award was conferred by the President of India, recognising his extraordinary sporting achievements at a young age.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

__
 
• PM Rashtriya Bal Puraskar__

 __
 
• It is India’s highest civilian honour for children aged between 5 and 18 years.
 
• The award recognises exceptional achievements in fields such as sports, bravery, arts, innovation, and social service.
 
 
 
• Vaibhav Suryavanshi’s Cricket Records__
 __
 
• Youngest centurion across multiple formats including List A, Syed Mushtaq Ali Trophy, and IPL.
 
• His 190-run innings in the Vijay Hazare Trophy stands among the most explosive performances in List A cricket.
 
 
 
• List A Cricket__
 __
 
• List A matches are official limited-overs domestic games, usually of 50 overs per side.
 
• They form a crucial pathway to international one-day cricket.
 
 
 
• Indian Premier League (IPL)__
 
 
• The IPL is India’s premier T20 league featuring domestic and international players.
 
• Becoming the youngest player and centurion highlights Vaibhav’s historic entry into elite cricket.

questions.question: What prestigious French civilian award was conferred upon veteran art director Thota Tharani?

options.text: Knight of the Legion of Honour
Chevalier de l’Ordre des Arts et des Lettres
Grand Cross of the Legion of Honour

questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Chevalier de l’Ordre des Arts et des Lettres.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__** 

__
 
• **Thota Tharani, renowned art director, was awarded the Chevalier de l’Ordre des Arts et des Lettres by the French government for his contributions to arts and cinema.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__** 

__
 
• **The award was presented by the French Ambassador to India on November 13, 2025, at Alliance Française in Chennai.**
 
• **Tharani’s work spans over four decades, with notable contributions to films like “Nayakan,” “Thalapathi,” and “Ponniyin Selvan I & II.”**
 
• **The award places him alongside prominent Indian cultural icons who have received this prestigious French honor.**
 
• **Tharani’s work has been recognized for its cultural preservation, architectural accuracy, and artistic innovation in cinema.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

__
 
• **Chevalier de l’Ordre des Arts et des Lettres**__

 __
 
• One of the highest civilian awards conferred by the French Republic.
 
• Awarded to individuals who have made significant contributions to the arts and literature globally.
 
 
 
• **Thota Tharani’s Career**__
 __
 
• Tharani is known for redefining art direction and production design in Indian cinema.
 
• His work spans multiple languages including Tamil, Telugu, and Hindi.
 
 
 
• **Notable Films**__
 __
 
• Tharani’s contributions to films like “Sivaji,” “Dasavatharam,” and “Sagara Sangamam” are widely celebrated.
 
• His art direction is known for its attention to cultural and historical authenticity.
 
 
 
• **Indian Honors**__
 
 
• Tharani has received numerous accolades including the Padma Shri in 2001 and multiple National and State Film Awards.

questions.question: What is the name of the first-ever results-based environmental award launched by India in 2026 to incentivize verifiable pollution reduction?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Zero Prize.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **The Government of India has officially launched the 'Zero Prize' to encourage measurable environmental protection.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **The Zero Prize is India's first results-based environmental award, meaning it only recognizes actual, verified reductions in pollution.**
 
• It is designed to move away from rewarding "efforts" and instead reward **measurable outcomes** in air, water, and land quality.
 
• The prize pool is **₹5 crore**, with specific allocations for successful interventions in three primary categories.
 
• The initiative aligns with India's **net-zero 2070** goal and the Swachh Bharat Mission.
 
• Zero Prize Framework__
 __
 
• Goal - Reach "Zero" pollution levels through innovation.
 
• Method - Third-party scientific monitoring and audits.
 
• Scope - Air, Water, and Land/Soil.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• Results-Based Award__

 __
 
• A system where the incentive is provided only after the **result is achieved and verified** by an independent agency.
 
 
 
• Mission LiFE__
 __
 
• A global movement led by India to encourage sustainable lifestyles and environmental conservation.
 
 
 
• Pollution Monitoring__
 __
 
• Uses tools like the **Air Quality Index (AQI)** and water quality parameters (BOD/COD) to measure the success of applicants.
 
 
 
• Incentivization__
 
 
• Encouraging startups and companies to invest in **green technology** by providing high-value financial rewards.
